experimental_method: Winkler titration (Pomeroy-Kirschman reagent) of dissolved oxygen in water stirred in a bath under a stream of air at constant temperature; equilibrium approached from above and below; 207 results averaged at 18 temperatures.
uncertainties_stated: temperatures to about 0.02 C; rms deviation of 207 results from calculated values 0.021 mg/l (max +0.7/-0.6 %); sea-water rms 0.060 mg/l
quality_remarks: Absorption coefficients are for solutions measured at room temperature so not exactly Bunsen; no thermal-expansion correction (about 0.2 % at low T, 0.5 % at 37 C). Sea-water (35.7 per mille) data are only given through the fitted equation (4) and Table IX/X (smoothed).
not_extracted_tables: Table I-VII, XI: Winkler-method interference and error tests (iodine loss, nitrite, azide etc.), not gas solubility
Table IX: solubility in pure and sea water, smoothed values from the authors' fitted equations (and Klots & Benson literature column)
Table X: comparison with Fox: derived from the fitted equation / literature
extraction_notes: Text layer was an OCR with punctuation errors; Table VIII was read from the 200 dpi image. Table IX not extracted as smoothed.
needs_pass2_reason: cells needed correction after the image check (OCR punctuation)
